key_nodes: GeometryNodeInputShortestEdgePaths — Dijkstra spanning forest; End Vertex=is_valley boolean field; Edge Cost=remapped elevation float; outputs Next Vertex Index + Total Cost
GeometryNodeEdgePathsToCurves — traces path strands from Start Vertices (is_ridge) to nearest End Vertex via the Next Vertex Index spanning tree
GeometryNodeInputNamedAttribute(data_type=FLOAT, name='elevation') — reads pre-computed vertex elevation stored by Python
ShaderNodeMapRange — remaps elevation from [-NOISE_HEIGHT, +NOISE_HEIGHT] to [0, 1] to ensure non-negative Dijkstra costs
GeometryNodeSplineParameter — Factor 0=ridge tip, 1=valley floor; drives RIVER_MIN_RADIUS→RIVER_MAX_RADIUS taper
GeometryNodeSetCurveRadius — applies tapered radius to river path curves
GeometryNodeCurvePrimitiveCircle(mode=POINTS, Resolution=5) — pentagon cross-section for low-poly river tube
GeometryNodeCurveToMesh(Fill Caps=True) — extrudes profile along each river path strand
GeometryNodeSetMaterialIndex(1) — assigns river material slot to tube mesh
GeometryNodeJoinGeometry — combines terrain (slot 0) with river tubes (slot 1) for single GLB export
python_attributes: elevation (FLOAT, POINT) — vertex Z after fractal noise displacement; used as edge cost
is_valley (BOOLEAN, POINT) — True where elevation <= VALLEY_THRESHOLD; marks river mouths
is_ridge (BOOLEAN, POINT) — True where elevation >= RIDGE_THRESHOLD; marks path origins
